entities.summary: Stanley McKenzie was an American professional basketball player in the National Basketball Association (NBA). Born in Miami, Florida, McKenzie played college basketball for the NYU Violets. He scored over 1,000 points in his collegiate career, and was inducted into the NYU Hall of Fame in 1984.
